long_recall_supplement: Supplemented the initial five-case run with the same long-recall fixture on each profile.
default_decision: Keep runtime-selected CPU threads and automatic KV precision. Four threads and explicit U8 did not show a RAM saving; no default change justified.
limitations: Sequential laptop runs, not controlled laboratory power/thermal conditions.
Quality rubric is small. Long-context reference-code recall failed across all CPU profiles.
CPU percentage is process CPU time / wall time, with 100 percent per logical CPU.
Sampled RAM peak can miss transients shorter than 50 ms.
